create_pipeline_svm_anova: create a pipeline that combines SelectPercentile feature selection, StandardScaler, and SVC for SVM-Anova classification
build_feature_selection_pipeline: build a pipeline using SelectPercentile with f_classif to select top features before SVM classification
run_cross_validation_svm: run cross_val_score on an SVM-Anova pipeline across varying feature percentiles to measure accuracy
load_iris_dataset: load the iris dataset using load_iris and add non-informative random features for classification testing
plot_classification_performance: plot cross-validation accuracy scores with error bars as a function of feature selection percentile
